constraints.coefficient_canonicalization: After validating all submitted constraints, replace each reflected coefficient pair by its arithmetic mean; leave the center unchanged. All numerical scores use this exactly palindromic schedule. This preserves each component total; no other rescaling is performed.

matrix_convention.bonds: Visit y then x; emit +x bond then +y bond at each site. X(x%2) or Y(y%2) contains that bond.
matrix_convention.hopping: H[c][source,target] = -amplitude*exp(1j*phase); reverse entry is its complex conjugate. Other entries zero.
matrix_convention.onsite: V=diag(site_potential), with no centering or rescaling
matrix_convention.phase: independent uniform(-phase_width,phase_width) per oriented bond, in radians
matrix_convention.field_value: independent equiprobable -1,+1 per site for binary; independent standard normal clipped to [-2,2] per site for clipped_normal; one equiprobable -1,+1 sign shared by every site for uniform_binary
matrix_convention.normalization: none; the mean bare hopping is the energy unit

sampling.shape_assignment: cycle listed shapes, equally often within every family
sampling.law: Every interval is continuous uniform including endpoints for purposes of support; all draws independent unless explicitly related. A scalar parameter is drawn once per instance. Bonds are conditionally independent. Sites are independent for binary/clipped_normal fields; uniform_binary shares one sign and therefore one constant onsite value across all sites. All randomness is redrawn independently per instance and independently across the eight families.

scoring.family_score: 1/sqrt(mean(point_ratio**2)); uniform over instances, dtau, repetition counts and both observables
scoring.core_score: geometric mean of the eight family scores
scoring.worst_family_score: minimum of the eight family scores
scoring.resource_score: 1 for structurally valid 33-stage artifacts completing within the worker caps; 0 otherwise
scoring.runtime_score: same as resource_score; measured worker wall seconds reported separately and not ranked
scoring.stable_evaluation: Multiply canonical positive stage exponentials in written order. For the palindrome construct L=E0...E15*exp(-h*a16*H[c16]/2), so P=L*L^H. If L=U*diag(sigma)*W^H, compute G=U*diag(expit(-2*r*log(sigma)))*U^H. Exact H=Q*diag(E)*Q^H gives exact G=Q*diag(expit(r*h*E))*Q^H. Propagators are compared against expm(-r*h*sum(H)); never score a numerically unstable inverse of I+P^r. These are stable evaluations of the stated mathematical errors, not different observables.
